The '''Hajara gang''' was a gang that operated prior to the [[Bordal Contagion]] of [[214 BBY]]. The gang raided [[Transport/Legends|transports]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corva Yag/Legends|Corva Yag]], forcing the head of [[Kett Shipping]], [[Findal Kett]], to stop running [[Convoy/Legends|convoys]] across the [[Little Minos Run]]. Some [[Time/Legends|time]] after the Bordal Contagion, the Hajara gang, as well as the [[Fujari]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], were destroyed within a week of each other.<ref name="EGtW:AC" />
